issue.title: Isolate bead path-resolution tests from ambient ancestor stores
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-en.4 and reproduced by the sase-en land audit on the integrated master tree. When /tmp/sdd/beads exists, five otherwise unrelated tests resolve that ambient ancestor instead of their tmp_path fixture: tests/test_bead/test_cli_changespec.py::test_create_plan_stores_sibling_workspace_plan_path_relative_to_primary, tests/test_bead/test_cli_golden.py::test_bead_cli_golden_contract[init], tests/test_bead/test_cli_resolution.py::test_workspace_context_rejects_primary_outside_pytest_sandbox, tests/test_bead/test_cli_resolution.py::test_plain_checkout_non_sidecar_record_falls_back_to_legacy_resolution, and tests/main/test_bead_fast_path_context.py::test_lightweight_context_uses_primary_vc_store_over_primary_non_vc_in_vc_mode. In one focused run all five failed while the adjacent contention regression passed. Scope: make these path-resolution tests and fixtures deterministic in the presence of an ambient ancestor bead store, preserving production legacy-resolution semantics and pytest's deny-by-default write containment.

payload.close_reason: Backlog triage 2026-08-05: deliberately deprioritized, not fixed, and not re-verified at master 0e40decdc. The project owner capped the reviewable task backlog at five, and these are narrow-scope follow-ups that did not make the cut: sase-ec (chat payload row recency ranking in the at-reference menu), sase-ef (source-free 'sase agent prompts validate' project disambiguation), sase-eq (bead path-resolution tests picking up an ambient /tmp/sdd/beads ancestor store — environment-dependent, not an xdist flake, so not consolidated onto sase-ct), sase-ex (legacy artifact created_at offset normalization, bounded to --since/date: bucketing near local midnight), and sase-f8 (stale generated memory shims and sidecar guide in the separate gh_bobs-org__bob-cli project, which additionally needs the owner's explicit memory-file permission). Scope and evidence stay readable here, and a +1 with fresh evidence reopens any of them automatically.
